title: How Procore works for manufacturing owners
summary: Procore is redefining capital delivery to help you move from reactive project oversight to proactive portfolio governance.
body_markdown:
Manufacturing is the backbone of our economy and a main driver of global innovation.


Construction is not your core business—it’s a necessary step between engineering design and closing the gap between commissioning, mechanical completion, and Start of Production (SOP).


At Procore, it’s all we do, **and we’re dedicated to helping you achieve your goals** .


You’re not just delivering projects, because your job isn’t done when the project is complete. You’re responsible for how capital investments perform over the lifecycle of that asset. And as capital becomes more expensive and projects become more complex, that responsibility only grows.


So what we’ve focused on is simple: purpose-built solutions for you. We want to help you turn your projects into a capital strategy you can actually see and give you a higher vantage point across your entire portfolio.


**Procore provides a capital project management platform for manufacturing owners** that serves as a unified command center for global greenfield plant builds, expansions, and retrofits.


By centralizing project data, Procore enables complete clarity and control over complex vendor networks, provides real-time cost and schedule risk mitigation to protect Start of Production (SOP) dates, and standardizes commissioning and turnover in a single, secure platform—so capital investments convert into production capacity on time and as planned.


Here are some ways we can help you:


**Capital Planning** puts a live multi-year plan beside the active portfolio, with cash flow forecasts modeled on how spend actually distributes across a project's life. A project slips a quarter and the forecast moves with it. Nobody rebuilds the spreadsheet.


**Funding Source Management** traces every dollar from origin to line item. On a program drawing CHIPS Act or IRA money, that's the difference between answering an allocation question and reconstructing one.


**Owners Hub** is a configurable dashboard built for deciding, not reporting. Financial scorecards can show where contingency is thinning before an overrun is real. Take a look below.


**Procore Connect** is visibility into partner data without partner friction. Your EPCs and OEMs work in their own accounts, with their own permissions and teams, but the record stays with you when they demobilize.


**Procore AI** is the invisible layer that takes you from signal to explanation. Trace why financial risk is climbing to what's driving it: the delayed submittal review, the change order about to drain contingency, the failed commissioning report. Put questions to your own specifications, submittals and field documentation without routing them to another stakeholder. Ask about portfolio health in plain language and get answers grounded in your project data.


Procore is a single, real-time visibility and control platform that can help you accelerate, protect, predict your capital portfolio health. That's what turns a start-of-production date into something you manage instead of something you hope for.
